guard: an unanswered describe is rendered against the rail it rode, so silence on the versioned rail is never printed as a verdict about the mesh
why: Issue #1630 measured the pre-fix rendering against a live mesh: a 0.49.0 CLI reported `no
manager answered on the endpoint rails` and offered `--local` while the 0.48.2 manager was up,
idle on the roster and answering `cotal ps` the whole time. The two rails are disjoint subject
spaces at the broker (SPEC 13.15), so the request reached nobody and the silence said nothing
Two things have to hold and each is mutated on its own. Core must RECORD the plane it published
on, or the renderer has nothing to scope the verdict with and falls back to the unscoped one.
And the renderer must READ it, or the fact is recorded and thrown away. Restoring either half to
its pre-fix form puts the false verdict back, which is what these mutations check the suite
The core mutation carries a build because this suite loads `@cotal-ai/core` through a package
specifier that resolves to `dist`; without it the mutated source is not the code that runs.

mutations.name: the renderer stops reading the rail and returns to the unscoped verdict
mutations.find:
error: instanceId !== undefined
        ? `manager instance ${instanceId} did not answer${versioned === undefined ? "" : ` on the ${versioned} rail`} (${detail})${skew}`
        : versioned === undefined
          ? `no manager reachable on the ep rails (${detail})`
          : `no manager answered on the ${versioned} rail (${detail})${skew}`,
mutations.replace:
error: instanceId !== undefined
        ? `manager instance ${instanceId} did not answer (${detail})`
        : `no manager reachable on the ep rails (${detail})`,
mutations.expectRed: versioned rail unpinned: the verdict names ep.v1 and never pronounces the mesh managerless

mutations.name: the describe deadline goes back to the rail-blind text and marker
mutations.find: const timeout = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => { timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new EpEnvelopeError("deadline-exceeded", `no describe reply from ${endpoint} within ${deadlineMs}ms on the ${rail} rail`, [{ kind: EP_UNANSWERED, endpoint, command: "describe", rail }])), deadlineMs); });
mutations.replace: const timeout = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => { timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new EpEnvelopeError("deadline-exceeded", `no describe reply from ${endpoint} within ${deadlineMs}ms`, [{ kind: EP_UNANSWERED, endpoint, command: "describe" }])), deadlineMs); });
mutations.expectRed: live: the CLI renders the ep.v1 skew as a named refusal, not as 'no manager reachable'
